items.heading: A Skills Assessment Compares What
items.text: A skills assessment compares what you can do with what a role needs. Free tests, self-rating and project feedback can each help, and each has limits.

items.heading: Pick One Target Role, Read
items.text: Pick one target role, read ten notices and list the skills they repeat. Rate yourself on each using the rubric, with evidence written down.
